I can help with that. To look into the duplicate charge, I need a couple of details:

1. **Your order number** (it looks like `LF-` plus six digits, e.g. LF-204518)
2. **The last four digits of the card** you were charged on

Once you provide those, I'll check whether one charge is a pending authorisation (which will drop off in 3–7 business days on its own), or if both have posted as actual charges—in which case I can process a refund of the duplicate within 3 business days of confirmation.
